# Design system

> A small design system: design tokens in the DTCG 2025.10 format built to CSS custom properties, three accessible HTML/CSS components with usage guidance, and automated checks. Version 0.1.0.

Components may only use semantic tokens (`--ds-color-*`, `--ds-space-*`, `--ds-shape-*`, `--ds-font-*`, `--ds-size-*`, `--ds-motion-*`). Palette tokens (`--ds-palette-*`) and raw colour values are rejected by `npm run check`.

## Rules

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): rules for building UI with the system and for changing it
- [README.md](README.md): structure, token layers, how to rebrand, governance and versioning

## Tokens

- [dist/tokens.resolved.json](dist/tokens.resolved.json): every token with purpose, CSS variable and value per theme
- [dist/tokens.css](dist/tokens.css): the CSS custom properties, light and dark
- [tokens/contrast-pairs.json](tokens/contrast-pairs.json): colour pairings guaranteed to meet WCAG contrast

## Components

- [Button](components/button/button.md): starts an action
- [Field](components/field/field.md): labelled single-line text input with hint and error
- [Callout](components/callout/callout.md): information, success, warning or error message

## Optional

- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): release history
- [tokens/ds.resolver.json](tokens/ds.resolver.json): how token files combine into themes
